status: CPU baseline scores under PROPOSED TEBench splits; not an official benchmark; not a reproduction of DOI 10.1021/acsaem.6c03156
features: matminer Magpie ElementProperty (132) on pymatgen Composition + temperature_K (experimental sources only)
tuning: Original RF untuned; revision HGB two-candidate grid selected by validation MAE only; see revision_20261107
own_paper_rule: own_paper_holdout role never used for fitting (train mask = role=='train')

revision_20261107.canonical_method: pymatgen Composition(strict=True), positive real elements only; get_integer_formula_and_factor(max_denominator=1000000); no token fallback for matching; failures remain unmatched

structure_secondary_key.reason: No experimental space-group/crystal-system or atomic-coordinate columns in either local experimental table; lattice a/c alone do not determine a crystal structure.

revision_20261107.model_grid: HGB max_leaf_nodes=[15,31], max_iter=150, learning_rate=.08, l2_regularization=1, min_samples_leaf=20; select by validation MAE; fit on train only; early_stopping=False

starrydata_points.filter: dropped points flagged missing_value, missing_temperature, composition_missing, magnitude_review, physical_sign_review or temperature_review (flags from build_starrydata.py); no other outlier removal, so unflagged extreme values (e.g. kappa up to 8200 W/mK) remain
starrydata_points.temperature: point-level: every measured (T, value) point is its own row; temperature_K is a feature; no averaging, no interpolation

notes.current_revision: See revision_20261107; original reference settings/notes are explicitly historical
notes.no_publication: New revision outputs remain local, no push/release/deposit
notes.legacy_metric_column_names: RF_MAE/RF_RMSE/RF_R2 hold estimator scores; model column identifies RF versus HGB
